elements.element: Customer has no non-compete or field-of-use restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 is omitted, and Section 12.3 expressly provides that nothing restricts Customer from conducting business in any field or territory and disclaims any non-compete commitment.

elements.element: The restriction covers only a named competing product.
elements.evidence: No operative restriction exists, so there is no restriction extending beyond a named competing product.

elements.element: The restriction applies during the term only.
elements.evidence: No operative restriction applies during or after the term.

elements.element: The restriction lasts no longer than 12 months.
elements.evidence: No operative restriction has any duration and therefore none lasts longer than 12 months.

elements.element: The restriction permits Customer's internal development.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 expressly permits Customer to develop any product or service without restriction.
Section 12.3 expressly permits Customer to acquire any product or service without restriction.
